briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies multi-agent race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny and infrastructure constraints. Multi-agent systems emerge as the dominant paradigm while security concerns mount across deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic and Google DeepMind countered with Claude 4 and Gemini 3.5 respectively, both emphasizing reasoning depth over scale. xAI and DeepSeek pushed open-weight alternatives.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell shipments ramp while Microsoft and Google announce new 100k+ GPU clusters. TSMC reports AI chip demand exceeding forecasts by 40%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols converge on a single standard before 2027?
